title: Attribution Guard Gaps
eyebrow: Proposal · #315 the attribution guard misses gh api and curl

short.lead: I ran the attribution guard from main against every route in #315, using a body that credits Claude. The guard refused only gh pr create. It let through all five gh api routes and curl. It also let through the footer GitHub actually appends ("Generated by Claude Code", linking to the Claude Code web page), even on gh pr create, because none of its six text patterns match that wording. The fix reuses the guard that exists: it widens which commands are checked, adds the missing footer patterns, and reads the body back after a pull request or issue is opened.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what changes.
items: The guard checks every way an agent writes to GitHub
gh api calls to a repo's pulls, issues and comments endpoints, and curl calls to api.github.com, go through the same check as gh pr create.
The body is read from files too
A body passed as -F body=@file or --input file is read the way --body-file is read today, by the same helper (_PR_BODY_FILE_RE in hook.py).

Two new text patterns: "Generated by" followed by a Claude Code link, and the Claude Code web link with no trailing slash. Today's patterns only know "Generated with" and the link with a trailing slash.
After opening, the body is read back
The platform adds its footer after the agent's text is sent, so no guard can stop it. A read-back says plainly whether it was added, instead of the reply claiming the credit is clean.
The eight cases I ran today (two gh pr create bodies, five gh api routes and curl) become verify.py cases. The suite then fails if any one is let through again.
The rule says what can't be removed
The rule text says the "with Claude" badge and the platform footer can't be removed from a cloud session, so agents stop promising to remove them.

changes: Which commands the attribution guard checks (_ATTRIBUTION_CMD_RE in hook.py)
Adds gh api and curl writes to GitHub.
Only git commit, gh pr create, edit and comment, and gh issue create, edit and comment.
Also gh api to repos/<owner>/<repo>/pulls, /issues and /issues/<n>/comments, and curl to api.github.com.
Read-only gh api calls, such as GET requests, are not checked.
Two new patterns for the footer GitHub appends.
6 patterns; none matches the "Generated by Claude Code" footer.
8 patterns, including that footer with or without a trailing slash on its link.
Tested today: the footer passes the guard on main.
The commit-branches rule and its detail file say what can't be removed.
The rule promises Claude credit is replaced everywhere.
The rule names the "with Claude" badge and the platform footer as outside the agent's control.
The house-rules version goes up one patch.
choices: How should the body be read back after a pull request or issue is opened?
A hook reads it back automatically and tells the agent if a footer was added
It always happens; it adds one GitHub call after each pull request or issue is opened.
The rule tells the agent to read it back
No extra hook, but it relies on the agent remembering.
#315 asks that the reply say plainly whether a footer was appended.
Where should the fix be built?
In today's hook.py, on a new branch from main
You get the fix now; the restructure (#306) moves it into the Safe git sub-plugin later.
Wait and build it inside the Safe git sub-plugin
No code moves twice, but the gap stays open until the restructure.
#315 is labelled ready-for-agent, so it can be built now. The plugin audit suggests holding new guard code until the restructure (#306).

wrapup.summary: The attribution guard misses five gh api routes, curl, and the footer GitHub appends. This fix makes the guard check those routes and match the footer wording. It cannot stop the platform adding the footer, so the read-back reports it.
wrapup.changing: The attribution guard in hook.py, a read-back after opening, the rule text, and verify.py.
wrapup.blocking: Your answers to the two choices.
